name: The Marketplace at Redwood Shores
summary: The Marketplace at Redwood Shores is a well-regarded community shopping center serving the affluent Redwood Shores peninsula and nearby Silicon Valley corporate campuses. With a 4.5-star rating and convenient location near Oracle headquarters, it offers a curated mix of retail, dining, and services for time-conscious professionals and local residents.
demographics: The Marketplace at Redwood Shores serves an affluent, tech-savvy demographic in the heart of Silicon Valley, with visitors primarily consisting of high-income professionals aged 30-55 working at nearby Oracle, Electronic Arts, and other technology companies. The trade area attracts dual-income households with above-average education levels and disposable income, seeking convenient shopping options near their workplaces and upscale residential communities. Shopping patterns reflect time-conscious professionals who value quality and convenience, with strong demand for quick-service dining, specialty retail, and service-oriented businesses during lunch hours and after work.
description: The Marketplace at Redwood Shores is a premier community shopping destination strategically located at 270 Redwood Shores Parkway in Redwood City, California, serving the affluent Redwood Shores peninsula and surrounding Silicon Valley communities. Nestled in one of the Bay Area's most desirable waterfront neighborhoods, this shopping center has become an integral part of the daily lives of local residents and the thousands of professionals working at nearby corporate campuses including Oracle's world headquarters and Electronic Arts. The center offers a carefully curated mix of retailers, restaurants, and service providers that cater to the sophisticated tastes and busy lifestyles of the area's tech-savvy population. With convenient access from Highway 101 and ample parking, The Marketplace provides a welcoming open-air shopping environment where visitors can efficiently complete their errands while enjoying the pleasant Bay Area climate. The center's strong reputation is reflected in its impressive 4.5-star rating from over 374 Google reviews, demonstrating its consistent ability to meet the high expectations of its discerning customer base.
